name: What materials are recommended for accessible kitchen sinks?

mainEntity.name: What materials are recommended for accessible kitchen sinks?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing materials for an accessible kitchen sink, prioritize durability, ease of cleaning, and resistance to impact. Stainless steel is a popular choice for its resilience and hygienic properties. Cast iron with an enamel finish also offers durability and a classic look. Ensure the sink edges are smooth and free of sharp corners to prevent injury. Consider a matte finish to reduce glare for visually impaired users.
acceptedAnswer.description: Recommended materials include stainless steel and enameled cast iron for durability and ease of cleaning, with smooth edges and matte finishes preferred.
